about: The SMS builder's lint limits, word lists and send-time windows. scripts/sms_draft_plan.py reads this file, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Values shared with campaign-qa and scenario-qa (their references/rules.json and references/message-checks.md) are marked 'Same as campaign-qa' in the notes: change them together. Each key is explained under notes. A lint blocker makes the plan's change blocked; a warning is shown with the plan.

notes.gsm7_single_chars: Characters that fit in one GSM-7 SMS. Same as campaign-qa (hard-coded there).
notes.gsm7_part_chars: Characters per segment once a GSM-7 message is split into several (the rest carries the joining header). Same as campaign-qa.
notes.ucs2_single_chars: Characters that fit in one UCS-2 (Unicode) SMS. One character outside GSM-7, such as an emoji or a curly quote, switches the whole message to UCS-2. Same as campaign-qa.
notes.ucs2_part_chars: Characters per segment once a UCS-2 message is split. Same as campaign-qa.
notes.segments_warning: A message estimated at more than this many segments is a warning: each segment is billed, and long texts read as spam.
notes.max_segments: A message estimated at more than this many segments is a blocker: the sms-template-best-practices guide says carriers reassemble up to 8.
notes.jinja_estimate_chars: Characters assumed for each {{ ... }} expression when counting length before rendering. Same as campaign-qa.
notes.sms_brand_window_chars: The brand name must appear within this many characters of the start of the message. Same as campaign-qa.
notes.name_placeholder_words: A sender name containing one of these words (one demo project's sender was literally a placeholder) is a warning, and the senders subcommand never picks it as the default.
notes.placeholder_hosts: Link hosts that are never a real destination: a blocker. Same list as campaign-qa.
notes.public_shorteners: Public link shorteners that carriers filter: a warning even when the user supplied the host. A brand-owned shortener is fine. Same list as campaign-qa.
notes.placeholder_patterns: Regular expressions (case-insensitive unless wrapped in (?-i:...)) for unfinished copy and merge tags from other tools: lorem ipsum, TODO, empty {{ }}, %%SLOT%%, <angle placeholders>, [URL], *|FNAME|*, {{FNAME}}, Klaviyo person.* and |default:. A match in the name or any message is a blocker. Covers campaign-qa's placeholder_tokens.
notes.opt_out_pattern: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for opt-out wording. Missing is a blocker on a marketing message, a warning on one the user says is purely transactional. Same pattern as campaign-qa.
notes.help_pattern: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for HELP wording. Missing is a warning, or a blocker when the draft says the sender is in a regulated industry.
notes.banned_jinja: Text that doesn't work in Bloomreach Jinja (see engagement-jinja-writer): a blocker. Same list as engagement-email-builder.
notes.default_schedule: The schedule a draft gets when the user sets no send time. create_sms_campaign requires one; {"type": "now"} means the campaign sends as soon as a person starts it in the Engagement UI.
notes.federal_window: US federal baseline for marketing texts, in the recipient's local time: start_hour inclusive, end_hour exclusive (21 means the last allowed minute is 20:59). A scheduled time outside it in any recipient time zone is a blocker: the skill never schedules inside quiet hours. Applied to every region.
notes.state_windows: Stricter state windows, from campaign-qa's 'SMS and MMS: North America' table: [start_hour, end_hour) per weekday, saturday and sunday in the recipient's local time; 'none' means no sends that day, and a missing day means the federal window. Outside the window of a state the draft names in regions is a blocker; of a state only implied by 'US' (or assumed) it is a warning. Not legal advice; state laws change.
notes.three_per_day_states: States that limit marketing contact to 3 messages per 24 hours on the same subject: a reminder warning when the audience can include them. Same as campaign-qa.
notes.assumed_regions: Where recipients are assumed to be when the draft gives no regions (every US state plus Canada), as campaign-qa does. The plan says so in a warning.
notes.restricted_terms: SMS terms grouped by restricted category. A match is a warning for a person to judge; it never decides carrier approval. Same list as campaign-qa.
